name: Kofu Castle
description: Kofu Castle was built 1583-1593 as the Takeda successor's base for the Tokugawa in Kai province. Its extensive white stone walls survive; the 2021-reconstructed Inui-yagura turret and panoramic view of Kofu are highlights.
notes: Free to walk the grounds; the Inui-yagura turret is open seasonally (fee).
